text:
alex: Heads up — noticed tenant credit spikes after the client key rotation rollout. invoice preview has duplicate token counts for the same logical request. Can we triage?

jamie: Seen this with retry storms + key handshake. example logs?

alex: Paste: ```
metering_event tenant=tenant-123 req_id=abc123 client_key=old->new retry=1 ts=2026-03-23T12:01:03Z tokens=145
metering_event tenant=tenant-123 req_id=abc123 client_key=new retry=2 ts=2026-03-23T12:01:18Z tokens=145
```
Same client-side req_id, but edge attributes both events separately because fingerprint changed.

priya: Current fingerprint = (client_key, route_hint, first_byte_ts). key rotation flips first field so dedupe misses.

jamie: Also our dedupe window is 5s; retries with backoff commonly land outside.

sasha: Options: extend dedupe window (memory cost), or prefer client-generated idempotency header as canonical key if present.

mike: Billing: once invoice lines materialize it's hard to undo. Prefer stop-duplication at ingest. Need short-term mitigation + SDK contract for longer term.

alex: Proposal: 1) require X-Client-Request-Id in SDK (canonical dedupe key). 2) legacy clients: fallback to tenant+session+normalized-prompt-hash. 3) temp: increase dedupe window to 60s for events matching client-side req_id across different fingerprints.

priya: For (2) we need deterministic normalization (trim, collapse whitespace, unify unicode). sha256 of normalized prompt ok, collisions tiny but possible.

jamie: Implementation note: dedupe namespace must be tenant-scoped. TTL configurable per-tenant.

mike: We'll also run a reconciliation job to detect duplicate invoice lines in the last 24h (same tenant, same tokens, same req_id) and flag for manual review.

billing-bot: Created metric metering.dedupe_fallbacks.count and dashboard under Billing -> Metering -> Dedupe.

alex: Can console surface a "dedupe candidate rate" card per route so customers see SDK impact?

sasha: UX: add small invoice-preview warning when dedupe_fallbacks > threshold and link to upgrade guide. reduces support churn.

jamie: Dev plan: make X-Client-Request-Id required in SDK v2.1. Server accepts but not requires for 2w, then enforce. Also add server-side heuristic path that checks cross-fingerprint matches and marks soft-dedup.

priya: Server schema: metering_event.addl_headers.x_client_req_id (nullable). Update parsers in ingest path.

alex: Owning: alex -> ingest runtime changes; sasha -> console card; mike -> reconciliation job; jamie -> SDK.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: ingest-runtime changes -> eng-platform-canary at 2026-03-24T10:00Z, full rollout 48h after if no anomalies.

mike: Can we add a short-lived similarity check: if normalized prompt similarity >95% + identical token count within 2m window, hold for 30s for dedupe? Only for events that would change invoice preview >5% to limit load.

priya: Computable but watch latency. Maybe gate similarity check behind cost-impact threshold per-tenant.

alex: Action items: 1) jamie - SDK header + release notes (ETA 3 days). 2) jamie/priya - server accept header + fallback dedupe (PR this week). 3) sasha - console card + invoice warning mockups (EOD). 4) mike - reconciliation job + alert tuning. 5) alex - monitor canary, rollback if dedupe_fallbacks > 500/h.

sasha: I'll mock dashboard. warning link -> support article + SDK migration checklist.

jamie: SDK will include opt-in flag so customers can send X-Client-Request-Id early + migration checklist.

alex: Tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes: 

mike: Will coordinate with finance for any interim credits if material overbilling occurs.

alex: Re-check 24h after canary starts.

jamie: ACK.

billing-bot: Alert rule rule/id=dedupe_fallbacks_high created: notify #eng-platform + #billing when tenant rate > 200/hr.

alex: (thread pinned)
